briefdescription.para: createTargetRegisterAllocator - Create the register allocator pass for this target at the current optimization level.

detaileddescription.para: Instantiate the default register allocator pass for this target for either the optimized or unoptimized allocation path.
This will be added to the pass manager by addFastRegAlloc in the unoptimized case or addOptimizedRegAlloc in the optimized case.
A target that uses the standard regalloc pass order for fast or optimized allocation may still override this for per-target regalloc selection. But -regalloc=... always takes precedence.

briefdescription.para: Add common target configurable passes that perform LLVM IR to IR transforms following machine independent optimization.
Add common passes that perform LLVM IR to IR transforms in preparation for instruction selection.
addInstSelector - This method should install an instruction selector pass, which converts from LLVM code to machine instructions.
addOptimizedRegAlloc - Add passes related to register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: Add standard target-independent passes that are tightly coupled with optimized register allocation, including coalescing, machine instruction scheduling, and register allocation itself.
CodeGenTargetMachineImpl provides standard regalloc passes for most targets.

briefdescription.para: This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes after register allocation pass pipeline but before prolog-epilog insertion.
addGCPasses - Add late codegen passes that analyze code for garbage collection.

detaileddescription.para: This should return true if GC info should be printed after these passes.

briefdescription.para: This pass may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before machine code is emitted.
Methods with trivial inline returns are convenient points in the common codegen pass pipeline where targets may insert passes.

detaileddescription.para: Methods with out-of-line standard implementations are major CodeGen stages called by addMachinePasses. Some targets may override major stages when inserting passes is insufficient, but maintaining overriden stages is more work. addPreISelPasses - This method should add any "last minute" LLVM->LLVM passes (which are run just before instruction selector).
